item.title: Multiple departments respond to grass fire along I-80 near McClelland, Iowa
item.description: A grass fire near McClelland, Iowa along Interstate 80 was brought under control Monday afternoon with help from multiple fire departments.

item.title: $60 million Council Bluffs riverfront development progresses as city council questions some aspects of project
item.description: A ribbon cutting is expected in May for the current phase of riverfront development in Council Bluffs, but city council members question some aspects of the $60 million, donor funded project.

item.title: Found Vintage Market forced to close as landlord plans to sell building
item.description: A Benson furniture store that's been a staple for 8 years is being forced to close as the landlord is selling the building. The owner had plans to hire special needs students from Benson High School.
